svg.title: Polarisation — Malus’ law
svg.desc: Science-symbols library hardware in an editable 2D optical train. A fixed polariser prepares linear polarisation; an analyser rotates around the beam axis. Ideal intensity follows I/I0 = cos squared theta. Source: https://openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-3/pages/1-7-polarization

g.inkscape:label: Polarisation axes and ideal curve
g.text: θ is the angle between the two transmission axes.
I₀: intensity after P1, before the analyser.

g.inkscape:label: Title and footer
g.text: Transmission through a fixed polariser and rotating analyser
